facets.gloss: How do you make internal associations and possible deductions outside of realistic information.
facets.daily_meaning: When the score is high, it is easier to see pictures and assumptions in unformed clues; when the score is low, it is more reliant on proven facts and processes.
facets.why_it_matters: It affects whether you first expand the possibilities when understanding complex problems, or first compress them to the boundaries of executable reality.

facets.gloss: Your sensitivity to form, atmosphere, rhythm and detailed texture.
facets.daily_meaning: High scores are usually more quickly affected by the quality of space, language, images, or sounds; low scores are less likely to allow aesthetic cues to change the focus of judgment.
facets.why_it_matters: It explains why some people are affected by the "unclear but not right" texture, while others are more concerned about whether the function is established.

facets.gloss: Are you willing to identify, access and express your inner feelings.
facets.daily_meaning: High scores are more likely to use emotions as a source of information; low scores are more likely to put feelings aside and return to tasks and facts.
facets.why_it_matters: It determines whether feelings are incorporated into judgments or downplayed as background noise.

facets.gloss: Are you willing to correct yourself with new practices, routes and experiences?
facets.daily_meaning: Those with high scores are more likely to try it themselves; those with lower scores are more likely to stick to familiar solutions until there is sufficient evidence for a new solution.
facets.why_it_matters: It affects whether openness stays at the understanding level or whether it actually enters behavioral experimentation.

facets.gloss: Your interest in abstract concepts, systematic relationships, and interpretive frameworks.
facets.daily_meaning: A high score will naturally ask about the underlying mechanism; a low score will pay more attention to whether the conclusion is directly usable.
facets.why_it_matters: It explains why a person makes the effort to understand the "why" rather than just the "how."

facets.gloss: The extent to which you can adjust to established rules, traditional positions, and value boundaries.
facets.daily_meaning: High scores are more willing to re-examine old rules; low scores are more in need of stable principles and inheritable boundaries.
facets.why_it_matters: It affects whether you first loosen your stance when faced with new ideas, or whether you first confirm whether it undermines the core order.
